# Chord Finder AI

> Paste a YouTube link or upload an audio file and get the song's key, BPM, time signature and chords — synced to the music as it plays, with guitar and piano chord diagrams and the main repeating progression pulled out on its own. A web app that works in any browser; nothing to install. One full analysis is free with no card.

Site: https://chordfinderai.com/
Support: support@chordfinderai.com

## What it does

- Analyzes any song from a YouTube link or an uploaded audio file (songs up to five minutes; longer tracks are trimmed to their opening five)
- States the key (major or minor), BPM and time signature up front
- Shows every chord in time with the music, with guitar and piano diagrams for each
- Distils the main chord progression — the loop the song is built on — from the full chord list
- Ear-training mode: hides the answers so you guess the key and chords by ear, then check
- Practice streaks and weekly goals
- A free, public chord library listing the key, BPM and main progression of songs already analyzed: https://chordfinderai.com/songs

## Pricing (November 2026)

- Free: one full analysis of any song, no card, plus four pre-analyzed songs delivered over the first week
- Pro: $12/month or $120/year — 15 analyses a month
- Premium: $29/month or $290/year — 40 analyses a month
- No ads on any tier

## Known limits

- Chords are detected as triads: no slash chords or inversions (true of all automatic chord finders)
- No stem separation, no native mobile app (it runs in the phone's browser)
- Each song is analyzed on request, taking a minute or two; there is no pre-processed catalogue
